title: IV Estimation of Heterogeneous Spatial Dynamic Panel Models with Interactive Effects
abstract: arXiv:2501.18467v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper develops a Mean Group Instrumental Variables (MGIV) approach for spatial dynamic panel data models with interactive effects, under large N and T asymptotics. Unlike existing approaches that typically impose slope-parameter homogeneity, MGIV accommodates cross-sectional heterogeneity in slope coefficients. The proposed estimator is linear, making it computationally efficient and robust. Furthermore, it enables asymptotically valid inferences without requiring bias correction. The Monte Carlo experiments indicate strong finite-sample performance of the MGIV approach across various sample sizes and parameter configurations. The practical utility of the methodology is illustrated through an application to regional economic growth in Europe. Our results provide evidence of conditional convergence in regional growth dynamics. Spillovers are shown to play a dominant role, particularly for investment rates where nearly four-fifths

translated_title: 具有交互效应的异质性空间动态面板模型的工具变量估计
translated_abstract: 本文在大N和大T渐近框架下，针对具有交互效应的空间动态面板数据模型，提出了一种平均组工具变量（MGIV）方法。与现有方法通常施加斜率参数同质性假设不同，MGIV能够容纳斜率系数的横截面异质性。所提出的估计量是线性的，因此计算高效且稳健。此外，它无需进行偏差修正即可实现渐近有效的统计推断。蒙特卡洛实验表明，MGIV方法在各种样本规模和参数配置下均具有出色的有限样本表现。通过对欧洲区域经济增长的实证应用，展示了该方法的实用价值。我们的结果为区域增长动态中的条件收敛提供了证据。研究表明溢出效应发挥着主导作用，尤其是在投资率方面，近五分之四……
tldr: 本文提出了一种针对具有交互效应的异质性空间动态面板模型的平均组工具变量（MGIV）估计方法，无需斜率同质性假设和偏差修正即可实现渐近有效推断，并应用于欧洲区域经济增长研究，发现了条件收敛及溢出效应的主导作用。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Mean Group Instrumental Variables (MGIV) estimator for spatial dynamic panel models with interactive effects, which accommodates cross-sectional heterogeneity in slope coefficients and enables asymptotically valid inference without bias correction, with an application to regional economic growth in Europe.
